title: A literal scalar whose last line holds only spaces is replaced whole, that line included
notes: The line of spaces is part of the scalar (here content, in yaml-test-suite L24T), so it goes with the scalar when the scalar is replaced; leaving it behind would put a stray whitespace line after the new value (docs/edit-semantics.md, Kit conventions). Both texts read back as the integer, so the exact bytes rest on a kit convention.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the pure backend left the line of spaces after the new value.
